newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil falls at close, outlook seen weak.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil falls at close, outlook seen weak.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Sentiment was weak with all traded contracts closing with double-digit losses. Lower-than-expected May 1-10 exports, selling by refiners, lower soyoil and a lack of follow through buying in refined products dampened sentiment. Trading was volatile and July futures broke the 1,260 ringgit support. The contract's next support is seen at 1,250.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL-Weakened with interest among CPO.
"It was a weak day with lower-than-expected first 10 days of May exports and refiners' selling pulling down prices in late trade," a trader said.
Traders expected the first 10 days of May exports to be above 200,000 tonnes but there was talk that it was around 168,000 tonnes. This could not be confirmed.
Lack of follow-through buying for refined palm oil products also sparked off selling interest, traders added.
"With the bearish sentiment, technical selling also appeared and third month July futures contract fell below the 1,260 ringgit level," a technical analyst said.
"The immediate support is 1,250 ringgit and if the July contract breaks 1,250 tomorrow, the next support will be 1,220," the analyst said.
At the close, the July contract lost 13 ringgit to 1,254 ringgit ($500.40) a tonne after trading between 1,252 and 1,266.
Physicals May (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,340 against bids of 1,335 after trading from 1,345 to 1,335. May (central) saw offers at 1,325 with bids at 1,320.
June (south) was offered at 1,325 versus bids at 1,320.
June (central) saw offers at 1,300 versus bids at 1,295.
In refined products, May RBD palm oil was offered at $560, June at $552.50, July at $547.50 and July/Aug/Sep at $542.50.
May RBD palm olein saw offers at $600, June at $590, July at $577.50 and July/Aug/Sep at $572.50. July was traded at $590.
May RBD palm stearin was offered at $427.50 and May/June palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $280.
